target.rawSql:
SELECT
  e.occurred_at AS time,
  sc.name || ': ' || e.event_type || ' — ' || t.name || '/' || s.slot_code ||
    COALESCE(' (' || mcm.code || COALESCE(', ' || mp.code, '') || ')', '') AS text,
  e.event_type AS tags
FROM mpp_connection_event e
JOIN solar_cell sc ON sc.id = e.solar_cell_id
JOIN mpp_tracking_slot s ON s.id = e.mpp_tracking_slot_id
JOIN mpp_tracker t ON t.id = s.mpp_tracker_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_connection_mode mcm ON mcm.id = e.mode_id
LEFT JOIN mpp_polarity mp ON mp.id = e.polarity_id
WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)

description: Long-term cell performance vs. its own baseline. PCE is normalized to each cell's average PCE over an initial reference window (default: first 24h after connection), so degradation is comparable across cells with different starting efficiencies. Irradiance & cell temperature are shown alongside to help identify a 'normal weather' period for interpretation.

panels.title: Normalized PCE (Degradation)
panels.description: PCE for each selected cell, normalized to 100% = its registered initial PCE (solar_cell.initial_pce, lab-measured under standard test conditions). For cells without a registered initial PCE, falls back to the cell's own average outdoor PCE during the first $baseline_hours hours after its first connection. MPP-tracking mode only, irradiance > $min_irr W/m². Server-side downsampled to the panel interval.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cells AS (
  SELECT name, area_cm2, initial_pce FROM solar_cell WHERE name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
),
baseline_window AS (
  SELECT c.name AS cell_name, c.area_cm2, c.initial_pce,
    fc.start_time AS baseline_start,
    fc.start_time + (${baseline_hours}::text || ' hours')::interval AS baseline_end
  FROM cells c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MIN(connected_at) AS start_time FROM mpp_connection_history(c.name)
  ) fc
),
baseline_power AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name, AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS avg_power
  FROM baseline_window bw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(bw.cell_name, bw.baseline_start, bw.baseline_end, NULL) mfc
  WHERE mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY bw.cell_name
),
baseline_irr AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name, AVG(im.irradiance) AS avg_irr
  FROM baseline_window bw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT irradiance FROM irradiance_measurement
    WHERE time >= bw.baseline_start AND time < bw.baseline_end AND irradiance > ${min_irr}
  ) im
  GROUP BY bw.cell_name
),
reference_pce AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name,
    COALESCE(
      bw.initial_pce,
      1000.0 * bp.avg_power / NULLIF(bi.avg_irr * bw.area_cm2, 0)
    ) AS reference_pce
  FROM baseline_window bw
  LEFT JOIN baseline_power bp ON bp.cell_name = bw.cell_name
  LEFT JOIN baseline_irr bi ON bi.cell_name = bw.cell_name
),
p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    mfc.measured_at AS t, mfc.power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND irradiance > ${min_irr}
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  p.t        AS time,
  p.cell_name AS metric,
  100.0 * (1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) / NULLIF(rpce.reference_pce, 0) AS normalized_pce
FROM p
JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
JOIN reference_pce rpce ON rpce.cell_name = p.cell_name
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Irradiance & Cell Temperature
panels.description: Fleet-wide irradiance (W/m², left axis) and cell temperature (°C, right axis), server-side downsampled to the panel interval. Use this to spot a 'normal weather' period for interpreting the degradation curve above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS time,
  AVG(irradiance) AS "Irradiance (W/m²)"
FROM irradiance_measurement
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS time,
  AVG(temperature) AS "Cell Temperature (°C)"
FROM temperature_measurement
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND temperature > -999
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Degradation Summary
panels.description: Per-cell reference PCE (registered initial_pce, or an outdoor baseline fallback — see Reference Source), latest normalized performance, linear degradation rate, and the estimated date the cell crosses $degradation_threshold% of its reference ('T$degradation_threshold'). Estimate is a linear extrapolation over the selected time range — narrow the range to a representative period for a more meaningful trend. A blank T-date means the trend is flat or improving.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cells AS (
  SELECT name, area_cm2, initial_pce FROM solar_cell WHERE name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
),
baseline_window AS (
  SELECT c.name AS cell_name, c.area_cm2, c.initial_pce,
    fc.start_time AS baseline_start,
    fc.start_time + (${baseline_hours}::text || ' hours')::interval AS baseline_end
  FROM cells c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MIN(connected_at) AS start_time FROM mpp_connection_history(c.name)
  ) fc
),
baseline_power AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name, AVG(mfc.power_mw) AS avg_power
  FROM baseline_window bw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(bw.cell_name, bw.baseline_start, bw.baseline_end, NULL) mfc
  WHERE mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
  GROUP BY bw.cell_name
),
baseline_irr AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name, AVG(im.irradiance) AS avg_irr
  FROM baseline_window bw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT irradiance FROM irradiance_measurement
    WHERE time >= bw.baseline_start AND time < bw.baseline_end AND irradiance > ${min_irr}
  ) im
  GROUP BY bw.cell_name
),
reference_pce AS (
  SELECT bw.cell_name,
    COALESCE(
      bw.initial_pce,
      1000.0 * bp.avg_power / NULLIF(bi.avg_irr * bw.area_cm2, 0)
    ) AS reference_pce,
    CASE WHEN bw.initial_pce IS NOT NULL THEN 'Initial PCE (lab)'
         ELSE 'Outdoor baseline (' || ${baseline_hours} || ' h)'
    END AS reference_source
  FROM baseline_window bw
  LEFT JOIN baseline_power bp ON bp.cell_name = bw.cell_name
  LEFT JOIN baseline_irr bi ON bi.cell_name = bw.cell_name
),
p AS (
  SELECT sc.name AS cell_name, sc.area_cm2,
    mfc.measured_at AS t, mfc.power_mw
  FROM solar_cell sc
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL mpp_measurements_for_cell(sc.name, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms) mfc
  WHERE sc.name IN (${cell:sqlstring})
    AND mfc.mode_code = 'mpp_tracking'
),
irr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 millisecond' * $__interval_ms, time) AS t, AVG(irradiance) AS irr
  FROM irradiance_measurement
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND irradiance > ${min_irr}
  GROUP BY 1
),
pce AS (
  SELECT p.cell_name, p.t,
    100.0 * (1000.0 * p.power_mw / NULLIF(irr.irr * p.area_cm2, 0)) / NULLIF(rpce.reference_pce, 0) AS normalized_pce
  FROM p
  JOIN irr ON p.t = irr.t
  JOIN reference_pce rpce ON rpce.cell_name = p.cell_name
),
regression AS (
  SELECT cell_name,
    regr_slope(normalized_pce, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t)) AS slope,
    regr_intercept(normalized_pce, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t)) AS intercept
  FROM pce
  WHERE normalized_pce IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cell_name
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cell_name) cell_name, normalized_pce AS latest_normalized
  FROM pce
  WHERE normalized_pce IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY cell_name, t DESC
)
SELECT
  rpce.cell_name AS "Cell",
  rpce.reference_source AS "Reference Source",
  rpce.reference_pce AS "Reference PCE (%)",
  l.latest_normalized AS "Latest Normalized Performance (%)",
  r.slope * 31557600.0 AS "Degradation Rate (%/year)",
  CASE
    WHEN r.slope < 0 THEN to_timestamp((${degradation_threshold}::numeric - r.intercept) / r.slope)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Estimated T${degradation_threshold} Date"
FROM reference_pce rpce
LEFT JOIN regression r ON r.cell_name = rpce.cell_name
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.cell_name = rpce.cell_name
ORDER BY l.latest_normalized ASC NULLS LAST

list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '— none (select cells below) —' AS __text, '__none__' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, name, name FROM solar_cell
) s
ORDER BY ord, __text

  SELECT 1, name, name FROM solar_cell
) s

list.name: min_irr
list.label: Min Irradiance (W/m²)
list.description: Irradiance floor for PCE — measurements below this are excluded to suppress low-light noise.

list.name: baseline_hours
list.label: Baseline Window (hours)
list.description: Length of the outdoor reference window (from each cell's first connection), used as the normalization baseline only for cells with no registered initial_pce. Cells with a registered initial_pce use that lab-measured value instead.

list.name: degradation_threshold
list.label: Degradation Threshold (%)
list.description: Performance level relative to baseline used to estimate the T-threshold date (e.g. 80 for T80).
